svg.text: SQL · S04 · Parameters, TRY/CATCH, NOCOUNT, FromSql — never concat
A named batch: parameters, body, CATCH, NOCOUNT.
Typed inputs. Rollback then THROW. FromSql still uses parameters.
Interpolated FromSql → typed @param → rows or THROW.
Concatenating EXEC from C# is injection, not a call.
GetOpenOrders: NOCOUNT ON and a typed uniqueidentifier.
SELECT o.Id, o.Status FROM dbo.Orders o
FromSqlInterpolated is the EF door. Keep it parameterized.

text.tspan: TRY/CATCH when two writes must pair
NOCOUNT ON unless a client needs counts
Hide every SELECT in an SP “because DBA”
